thread:
hana_finance: Heads-up: invoice INV-2026-05-02 for Nimbus shows 2,400,000 embedding units for Apr 28 but ledger/DB show 240,000. Looks like a 10x on the invoice export.

luke_billing: Flagged. Will pull the raw export CSV and deploy history.

billing-bot: export-job #exp-20260502 completed 2026-05-02T04:12:03Z

sara_ops: Quick check: metering DB sum for nimbus between 2026-04-28T00:00 and 2026-04-29T00:00 => 240000. No duplicate rows.

luke_billing: Export CSV sample: embedding_units=2400000. Huh. That's x10. Searching deploys around 2026-05-02 03:45 UTC.

luke_billing: Deploy note found: config export.embedding_scale was set to 10 in the rollout metadata (accidental).

hana_finance: Root cause likely exporter config. Action list: 1) void invoice and reissue corrected invoice 2) issue credit memo 3) run a re-export dry-run for the customer 4) sweep recent invoices for same deploy window.

mike_sales: Customer contacted support. I'll hold off messaging until we have corrected invoice. Proposed text: "We identified an internal billing export issue that overstated embedding usage by 10x on Apr 28. We're issuing a corrected invoice and credit."

luke_billing: Re-export dry-run: `billing export reprocess --customer nimbus --start 2026-04-28 --end 2026-04-29 --dry-run` -> embedding_units=240000.

sara_ops: I've rolled back the config to embedding_scale=1 and added a pre-flight check to the exporter service to reject non-1 scales unless feature_flag=true. Also added an alert for export delta >2x vs DB.

hana_finance: Kevin (CFO) OK to approve credits up to $15k for customer experience?

billing-bot: approval-request #apr-1783456789 created for kevin_cfo

mike_sales: Customer rep: please send corrected invoice once available; I'll include the credit memo and short explanation.

luke_billing: Created INV-2026-05-02-R1 and CM-2026-05-02-NIMBUS. Corrected embedding_units=240000. Sending to finance queue for posting.

hana_finance: Thx. Finance will reconcile other invoices in 03:30-04:30 UTC deploy window and escalate if any other mismatches found.

mike_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks for the quick response  appreciated." :thumbsup:
